##### Project general facts

Olfah by Alef is a walkable residential community designed around a forest-inspired landscape, blending nature with urban living. The masterplan brings together a collection of residential buildings of varying heights, each with a ground floor and generous residential levels. Contemporary architecture focused on simplicity and functionality features large windows and open facades that bring in daylight and fresh air and frame panoramic views. The project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with larger homes including a maid's room.

Amenities are woven through green landscapes and shaded pathways. Residents can enjoy an infinity pool and a sports pool, indoor and outdoor gyms and an amphitheatre for community events. Families benefit from a splash water feature, a sand play zone, climbing areas and a kids' play area, while barbecue areas, pocket rest areas, lounge areas and open green spaces with landscaped hills create relaxing places to unwind outdoors, close to home and connected by walkable streets.

Interiors are finished in light colours and high-quality materials, with layouts designed for maximum functionality and comfort. Living and dining areas open onto balconies, and selected ground floor homes enjoy private gardens. Apartments include laundry areas and practical storage, while three-bedroom homes add a maid's room for extra flexibility. Kitchens are fitted with appliances, and homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture and decoration to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Muwaileh is a fast-growing residential district of Sharjah, popular with families and students thanks to its central position and established infrastructure. The area combines residential communities, schools, supermarkets, clinics and shopping centres, and sits close to University City and the Sharjah Academy for Astronomy, Space Sciences and Technology, offering a calm suburban lifestyle with everyday essentials, parks and community facilities close at hand.

University City, Sharjah International Airport and Al Zahia with its shopping centre are a short drive away. Emirates Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Dhaid Road connect residents with Dubai, Ajman and the rest of the emirate, while Dubai International Airport and central Dubai are within comfortable driving distance for daily commuting, keeping work and leisure in both emirates within easy reach.

Sharjah offers freehold ownership to all nationalities in designated areas, and Muwaileh is one of the most popular districts for families and students. Accessible entry points compared with Dubai, combined with steady demand from tenants working in both emirates, support attractive rental yields. A nature-led masterplan by an established developer strengthens long-term value and resale prospects for owners and investors alike.
